reviews.text: Terrible treatment. We took our dog there and they returned her beaten. After we told them, they scolded us for bringing her in dirty (as if that's why you take your dog there!). We went back to complain to the place, and they recommended a veterinarian to see the wounds THEY inflicted. Our dog is old and came back unable to walk and with bruises. Don't take your animals there; it's a terrible place.

Terrible treatment of the animals. Places like this shouldn't exist anymore. They do it for money, not out of love. People entrust their pets to you with all their love, and you lack the sensitivity to treat other animals properly. It's a shame. May life treat you the way you treat the animals.
I love how they groom my puppies so well and they're very good, they treat my pets and their clients very well, I highly recommend them
Excellent place and very good service. ✨️
They're animals, but the people who work there sent my dog ​​back with head injuries. Please DO NOT take your pets there.
They have good products and are very friendly.
I absolutely loved it. Prices, service, products. Everything.

I took my dog ​​to this place a few years ago. The vet told me my dog ​​had distemper (even though he didn't have any of the characteristic symptoms). He made me pay for useless tests and told me that he did indeed have distemper and that euthanasia was an option to consider. I went to another vet for a second opinion, and he told me it was definitely not distemper and gave me the correct diagnosis: a herniated disc. Today my dog ​​is still with me, and his vet was already offering to euthanize him because of a misdiagnosis.

I arrived at 7:00 AM to ask a simple question. The door was open, the "Open" sign was on, the posted hours said 8:00 PM, and the young woman at reception told me they were already closing. I explained that it was just a question, but she said no, she had already shut down the system. I was the one who had to ask when I could return because she wasn't even kind enough to let me know; she preferred to take a swig from her water bottle. To me, this is not only a lack of attention but also a lack of manners. If this is how she treats me, how will she treat pets?
Excellent service, the doctor was super friendly

Terrible service! I took my puppy, who's a few months old and very skittish, to be bathed. The person bathing him snatched him from me and pulled him roughly! The woman didn't say a word! As for the veterinary clinic, they don't explain anything, and if you arrive after 6 pm, they charge more because it's the night shift! There are better veterinary options.
Excellent service. They treated my puppy very well and always with great kindness and trustworthiness.
One of the best places for pets.
They need to improve the way the young lady who serves customers treats them; she can be rude, and if she's like that with people, I don't know how she treats the animals.
